title: Jay Feely X post
text:
Praying for Israel 
I Took these in April. I was shocked that Israel provides power and water to the Gaza Strip despite terrorist attacks continually coming from there. Today Hamas declared war on Israel, executing Israeli citizens. 
Israel has every right to defend itself!
